author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the FC 27 Ultimate Team trailer, the latest Deep Dive from EA Sports FC 27. Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favorite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season. EA Sports FC 27 is launching on September 25 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: EA Sports FC 27 - Official Ultimate Team Deep Dive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the release date trailer for Allogloom, a psychological horror point-and-click puzzle adventure game developed by Galactic Ghosty. Players will traverse the Gruesome Grove to collect items, uncover deep truths, and meet unique individuals and monsters alike. Allogloom is launching on October 10 for PC (Steam).
title: Allogloom - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the launch trailer for Lunarium, a top-down action fantasy RPG developed by Lunarium Game Studio. Players will set out to save a dying world through challenging battles, diverse areas, and powerful abilities. Lunarium is out now PC (Steam).
title: Lunarium - Official Launch Trailer
